client.business_model: Multi-state provider of home health, hospice and rehabilitation therapy services delivered in patients’ homes
client.client_history: Founded in 2007 by physical therapist David Jackson in Tyler, Texas, Choice Health At Home has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions to serve patients across Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas and Louisiana. In 2021 the company received growth investment from private-equity firms Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings, positioning it for continued expansion in the post-acute home-based care market.

revenue.notes: No credible revenue figures for Choice Health At Home found in company documents, official website, press releases, LinkedIn or reputable databases.

locations.notes: Company and web sources indicate operations in several states but do not disclose the number of branch locations or agencies.

employees.source: LinkedIn company page for Choice Health At Home (accessed Feb-2026)
employees.notes: LinkedIn shows 326 employees. Other sources provide conflicting estimates ranging from 86 (Bitscale.ai) to 1,000-5,000 (SignalHire). Using LinkedIn figure as the only specific number, but large discrepancy reduces confidence.
